name: supraman
description: Supraman's sessions: the skills workspace-controller (plans a task across a workspace's repos, one approval, starts repo-controllers) and repo-controller (runs one repo's Workman run with /rlarch:controller), plus hooks that log lifecycle events to the Supraman home's events and re-inject the session's role on SessionStart. Loaded only with --plugin-dir on sessions Supraman launches.
